result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well-formed. The horizontal carousels and the bottom-cut card are intentional and excluded. One navigation-state problem stands out, along with a few minor styling and contrast concerns.

issues.description: The bottom navigation highlights 'Profile' as the active tab, yet the screen shows the restaurant home feed. The active tab state does not match the content, which is confusing, and 'Home' looks inactive.
issues.suggestion: Set the active state on 'Home' when this feed is displayed, and make sure the tab highlight follows the current route.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (e.g. '€0.90 delivery', the '(500+)' rating count, and the inactive tab labels) is light on a white background and has low contrast. The white promo text on the mid-green banner is also fairly light.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary gray text and the inactive tab labels to meet WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast. Deepen the banner green slightly if needed.

issues.description: The time pills on the 'Fastest near you' cards (e.g. '15–25 min') sit over the image and slightly overlap the plate illustration. The heart icon on the '−20%' pizza card has a dim, low-contrast background circle against the dark wood.
issues.suggestion: Position the badges consistently and away from the key image content. Give the favorite button a clearer, higher-contrast background.
